item.title: Microsoft global outage continues, impacting Outlook and cloud services
item.description: Microsoft’s massive outage, which began Thursday and disrupted Outlook email, Teams, and a wide range of cloud services worldwide, is slowly recovering as the company works to restore full functionality. item.title: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over uninspected Iran nuclear site
item.description: The United Nations nuclear watchdog has said it is "increasingly concerned" about a nuclear facility in Iran that it has not been allowed to inspect. item.title: Fed reduces rate-setting meetings in 2027, October session becomes non-voting
item.description: The Federal Reserve announced Thursday that its October 2027 meeting will not include a vote on interest rates, reducing the number of rate decisions from eight to seven that year.
